title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Job Title: Data Entry Specialist
Location: Farmington Hills, MI - 100% Onsite
Duration: 6-Month Contract
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week

Overview
TalentFish is seeking a detail-oriented Data Entry Specialist for a six-month onsite contract opportunity supporting a sales organization with tariff recovery data management. This position is ideal for someone with exceptional data entry accuracy, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Gather monthly tariff impact data for multiple customers from various manufacturing plant teams.
  • Utilize import documentation (7501 forms) and component invoices to collect and organize required information.
  • Learn the different tariff classifications and accurately identify the applicable tariff type for imported components.
  • Complete customer-specific documentation on a monthly and quarterly basis using collected tariff data.
  • Review completed data with the Sales team to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Track customer submission deadlines and ensure all required documentation is completed on time.
  • Follow up with manufacturing plant teams regarding missing, incomplete, or late data submissions.
  • Support Sales planning by providing historical, planned, and paid tariff impact information by tariff type.
  • Assist with tariff impact forecasting and customer credit tracking to support efficient recovery efforts.
  • Perform additional data entry and administrative support duties as assigned.


Qualifications

  • Excellent data entry skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Manufacturing, sales support, or administrative experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Willingness to learn new processes and systems.


What You'll Bring

  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable follow-through and accountability.
  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple internal teams.
  • Experience with tariff or trade compliance is highly ideal.

Training will be provided for the tariff recovery process, data collection methods, and required reporting documentation.

Compensation Information
The expected salary range for this position is $20 - $25 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications. This role also qualifies for comprehensive benefits such as health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off. TalentFish is committed to pay transparency and equal opportunity. The salary range provided is in compliance with applicable state and federal regulations.

This role requires authorization to work in the U.S. without current or future visa sponsorship.

All offers are contingent upon the completion of a background check, which may include but is not limited to reference checks, education verification, employment verification, drug testing, criminal records checks, and any required certifications or compliance requirements based on the end client's background check policies and applicable laws.

title: Sr Infrastructure Engineer - Endpoint
description:
Job Title: Senior End User Computing Engineer - VDI
Primary Location: Remote, Must Reside in the US and work within CST timezone
Position Type: Contract, 12 Months

Overview
TalentFish is currently seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Sr. EUC Engineer- Virtual Desktop Infrastructure for our premier client. This is a 6-month contract role that will be primarily remote. We are seeking candidates residing near Chicago, Illinois who are open to potential in-person team building and/or meetings.

As the Senior Infrastructure Engineer/Architect and Subject Matter Expert (SME), you will lead a strategic initiative to assess, optimize, and modernize the organization's Endpoint Management, Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), and Contractor Access environment. This individual will evaluate the current-state architecture, recommend scalable and secure solutions, and implement improvements that enhance endpoint management, secure remote access, and the overall end user experience.

If you're passionate about designing modern infrastructure solutions while maintaining a collaborative team culture, we invite you to apply!

What You Bring to the Role
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
• 5-7+ years of experience as an Endpoint Engineer, End User Computing Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, SCCM Engineer, or similar role.
• Intune & SCCM/MECM Subject Matter Expert (SME) highly preferred.
• Architect mindset with experience designing and implementing modern endpoint technologies and cloud-based solutions.
• Experience assessing existing infrastructure, identifying opportunities for improvement, and architecting scalable, secure endpoint solutions.
• Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) solutions including Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365 Cloud PC, Citrix, VMware Horizon, or similar technologies.
• Experience designing secure remote access and contractor access solutions within enterprise environments.

Strong hands-on experience with:
• Intune & SCCM/MECM architecture and administration
• Microsoft Intune & Autopilot (including Autopilot profiles)
• Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)
• Windows 365 Cloud PC
• Microsoft Endpoint Manager (MEM)
• Azure Active Directory / Hybrid Active Directory
• Mobile Device Management (iOS & Android)
• Cloud Gateway Management (CGM)
• Microsoft 365 / Office 365
• PowerShell scripting
• Windows 10/11
• Group Policy
• Application packaging
• WSUS
• Third-party application patching
• Endpoint security
• Vulnerability management
• Log aggregation
• Virtualization technologies
• Windows Server technologies
• Print Management

Strategic & Architectural Responsibilities
• Lead the assessment, design, and optimization of the organization's Endpoint Management, Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), and Contractor Access environment.
• Evaluate current-state infrastructure and develop architectural recommendations that improve scalability, security, performance, and user experience.
• Design and implement modern endpoint management solutions leveraging Intune, SCCM/MECM, Azure, Autopilot, Windows 365 Cloud PC, and Azure Virtual Desktop.
• Develop architectural standards and best practices for endpoint management, virtual desktop infrastructure, and secure remote access.
• Provide strategic guidance and technical leadership while partnering with Infrastructure, Security, and End User Computing teams.
• Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Project Management Responsibilities
• Manage multiple infrastructure initiatives simultaneously.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements and technical solutions.
• Develop project plans, timelines, resource allocation, and risk mitigation strategies.
• Track project progress and communicate updates to stakeholders.
• Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business objectives.

What You'll Do
• Assess the current VDI and Contractor Access environment and develop recommendations for modernization and optimization.
• Design and implement improvements to Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365 Cloud PC, and endpoint technologies to improve performance, scalability, and security.
• Enhance secure remote access capabilities for employees, contractors, and third-party users.
• Engineer and support Microsoft Endpoint Manager (MEM/MECM/SCCM) environments.
• Manage endpoint policies using Intune and Group Policy.
• Manage Azure Active Directory and Hybrid Active Directory.
• Create and enhance reporting across endpoint technologies, devices, patching, and incidents.
• Resolve complex escalated endpoint engineering issues.
• Research and evaluate new endpoint technologies and solutions.
• Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and End User Computing teams to deliver scalable, modern endpoint solutions.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Compensation Information
The expected salary range for this position is $50 - $65 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications. This role also qualifies for comprehensive benefits such as health insurance and paid time off. TalentFish is committed to pay transparency and equal opportunity. The salary range provided is in compliance with applicable state and federal regulations.

This role requires authorization to work in the U.S. without current or future visa sponsorship.

All offers are contingent upon the completion of a background check, which may include but is not limited to reference checks, education verification, employment verification, drug testing, criminal records checks, and any required certifications or compliance requirements based on the end client's background check policies and applicable laws.
